limitations: Bounded source discovery is not an exhaustive reconstruction. A missing confirmation is not proof none existed. No weekly starts are inherited.

No receiver-role features, target receiving outcomes, actual starter columns, forecasts, losses or returns were extracted. Search engines automatically surfaced historical/target scores and player totals in snippets; these are incidental exposure, excluded from qualification. This is not an outcome-unread research context.

Two site-qualified queries omitted the explicit domains array; results included off-domain spillover. Only official NFL/team results were used or downloaded; off-domain results were excluded. The exact queries and unfiltered returned receipts are preserved.

Search budget was applied to six discovered incumbent-injury candidates: Tua concussion2, Tua hip1, OConnell thumb2, Minshew collarbone2, OConnell knee2, Herbert ankle2. OConnell knee could nest within the continuing Minshew absence for clustering. Do not count these as independent episodes. Treat the four LV collarbone/knee follow-ups as a protocol ambiguity if the declaration merges them already at discovery; this is explicitly disclosed rather than silently relabelled.

All newly used pages retain historical prefixture JSON-LD clocks and prospective wording. Current asserted clocks do not prove the wording existed at those times or an original receipt. Retained prior Miami HTML hashes have no saved full bytes; those sources were reused without another fetch.
MIA hip page’s JSON-LD revision is Dec29 15:47:22.687Z, later than the visible Dec28 update in search. Conservative metadata clock is retained; it remains conditional and unpriced.

Price counts are provisional identity/retrospective-roster ceilings only. Prior membership, air-yard role and receiver availability remain untested. The source export lacks raw API responses; grouping omits clocks and may overwrite same-side prices while preserving first metadata. Prices are not execution proof.
The four qualified fixtures each have exactly one eligible snapshot and no same-time line ambiguity; the earliest-post-announcement quote addendum does not change these counts.
